chunks: It is narrated from Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) that he said:
"Whoever visits me, his sins are forgiven, and he does not die poor."

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Al-Sadiq (The Truthful), a title for Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and material benefits of visiting the Imams according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) underscores the comprehensive nature of spiritual intercession, linking the metaphysical reward of sin forgiveness with the tangible blessing of financial sufficiency. In Shia tradition, this dual promise highlights the Imam’s role as a conduit for both divine mercy and worldly sustenance, reinforcing the concept that *ziyarah* is not merely a ritual but a means of holistic spiritual and material elevation.
